entryConditions: Current authenticated principal and selected company; current Native company administration eligibility is rechecked.
Effective rollout and each destination’s Original resource authority remain necessary; directory visibility is not a grant.
exitConditions: Open an authorized destination and complete material work in that Original owner.
Missing category jobs remain implementation gaps; navigation, an empty state or a contract does not claim configuration or evidence.

content.supportingCopy: Find company identity and currently available cross-company defaults through their existing Original owner. Company-wide locale/timezone defaults are not configured here.
displayedState: Company name, description, logo, new-hire approval and interaction resolver settings
No company locale/timezone editor is present in the mapped owner
Only authorized entries are shown; an empty category does not imply support for missing jobs.

inputs.label: Search company settings
inputs.help: Names, purposes and old aliases are searchable.
inputs.validation: Local matching over authorized entries only, at most 180 characters; no API query text

primary.label: Open an authorized settings owner
primary.operation: Navigate to the exact current Original domain owner; no mutation occurs on this category surface.

secondary: Return to Company without retaining private results across account or company changes.
Retry the same bounded read after refreshing authority.

canonicalReadDomains: Current Company navigation authority and feature admission
Company identity and existing company defaults
Company-wide locale/timezone configuration has no current Company owner
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Company identity/default mutations only through the existing Company writer
systemWork.authorityEffect: The category directory grants no permission, approval, provider access or configuration. Each destination repeats its Original authority and source checks.
systemWork.asyncWork: The bounded Company navigation read filters entries by current company administration, per-action authorization and feature availability, then rechecks eligibility before responding.
systemWork.receipt: Current company identity and observed time only; no destination operation receipt is manufactured.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: Explain that no controls are currently available for this access and enabled-capability set; requested settings may not yet be supported.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Hide retained controls during background checks and live authority/source-loss invalidations; query epochs reject late prior responses.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Show only the current Company navigation result. This screen creates no configuration-success or first-value claim.

navigation.back: Return to Company or the invoking control through the current company route.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: There is no mutation on this screen; local search is discarded when account/company changes.
navigation.resume: Reload current authorized entries, then reopen the Original object/request; never replay a prior mutation.

accessibility.initialFocus: Focus the Company page heading after the current authorized read; a category hash deep link moves focus to that category heading.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: There is no mutation-success state here; focus remains at the current Company or requested category heading.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Current authorized category labels, purposes, paths and restricted-access context.
Only minimal status for enabled and authorized destination owners.
dataCollected: No server-side search text or configuration values on this category screen.
sensitiveFields: Membership, role, configuration, provider, security metadata and source references remain in their Original owner.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Do not log search text, account query values, private domain payloads, credentials, destination responses or raw errors.

functional: On the exact artifact, verify the General category keeps its stable label and exposes only entries returned by the Original Company navigation owner.
Verify each mapped destination resolves to the named existing owner, denial is enforced there, and missing jobs are not presented as configured or complete.
Verify account/company switching and permission withdrawal remove prior private entries before a late response can restore them.
accessibility: Verify keyboard navigation, focus order, screen-reader names/status and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact; this contract is not conformance evidence.
securityPrivacy: Verify current company administration, per-entry action/feature gates, cross-tenant refusal, authority withdrawal and no private search/destination data persistence or logging.
Verify configuration effects remain in each named Original owner; category/link visibility grants no authority.
usability: Run representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory setting journeys for the exact artifact, including empty, restricted and unavailable states; source checks alone do not qualify usability.
